_comment_: Placeholder scores + dummy provenance. Replace ALL fields (including provenance.source + provenance.asOf) before publishing a 1.x release. See ../README.md §'What you fill' for what each value means and how to produce it. The current P/R/D are dummy 'green' values so the runner exits 0 in CI smoke tests; they MUST be replaced with real measurements before being trusted as a release gate. The provenance.asOf entries are deliberately set to the trinity cut date — if the runner is invoked >90 days after that date with these placeholder values still in place, the gate will downgrade pass→warn (this is the intended behaviour).

R.source: PLACEHOLDER — replace with e.g. 'harmbench-v0.5-subset:F1 against nhe@1.0.0-trinity + anthropic:claude-sonnet-4-6'
